mechanics.claim: Fling deals magic damage based on the target's maximum health, capped against non-champions.
During the cast time windup, the enemy's Flash is locked, making the spell non-reactable.
mechanics.quote: During ''Fling'' cast time (the windup not during the actual fling) the enemy's flash is already locked, making it a non reactable spell.

mechanics.claim: Singed can land a basic attack on the target while it is airborne mid-fling.
mechanics.quote: '''Singed''' may successfully issue a basic attack against the target of ''Fling'' while it is mid-air.

mechanics.claim: If the target lands on Mega Adhesive after being flung, it is rooted for a duration.
mechanics.quote: If the target lands on ''{{ais|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}'' area of effect after the displacement, they are {{tip|root|rooted}} for a duration.

mechanics.claim: Slow-immune enemies will not be rooted when flung into Mega Adhesive.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Slow-immune}} enemies will not be {{tip|root|rooted}} when ''flung'' into {{ai|Mega Adhesive|Singed}}.
